blocks.text: Recall “levels of biological organization” that you have studied in your previous classes. You got a brief introduction about biological molecules in reference of levels of biological organization. Now you would get detailed study of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids as well as the importance of water and the role of conjugated molecules.
